notes.title: Freestyle Update!
notes.content:
All new Freestyle levels have been added to the world hubs. There is a normal and nightmare version for each world 1-5.

In freestyle mode, you rack up points by performing different tech-skill, then keep the combo going and boost your multiplier by hitting crystals. Enter the finish during your combo for bonus points! Compete with the world on the leaderboard!

Need some tips?
- Some actions like moonwalk are considered special moves and deliver massive points
- All actions stale the more you do them, so mix up for big points
- Using different moves to hit the crystals is also key for huge scores
- Maximize your combo time before hitting the next crystal
- Finish during combo time for the finish points to be multiplied by your current multiplier

Freestyle update also comes with 4 new achievements + you can make custom freestyle levels in the level editor :)

notes.title: NIGHTMARE UPDATE
notes.content:
The NIGHTMARE update is a huge content update that's absolutely free. Here's what's new:

[u][b]MAJOR[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Nightmare Levels (Challenging remixes of every original level!)
[*] Tag Battle Mode (2-4 Local Multiplayer)
[*] Ranks for every level (S, A, B, C)
[*] Formidable endgame (climb ???? and face ????) + includes headbanging new music by c4nvm
[/list]

[u]Minor[/u]
[list]
[*] New environments for Earth, Air and Mind hub worlds
[*] Hub level indicators
[*] Leaderboards show on level entry
[/list]

This update also comes with a new logo and promo art for the game!

To celebrate this release, the game is at a 15% discount till Monday

Thank you everyone for your support! I hope you enjoy the game :)
